content.short: Maia DAO is an omnichain yield and liquidity powerhouse on Arbitrum featuring specialized management and protocols.
content.description: Maia DAO is a comprehensive decentralized finance ecosystem operating on Arbitrum, designed to unify fragmented liquidity and optimize yield strategies across multiple chains. The ecosystem encompasses several specialized products, including Hermes (an omnichain liquidity marketplace), Talos (automated liquidity management), and Ulysses (an omnichain interoperability protocol). Together, these tools provide users and protocols with a robust framework for managing capital efficiency. Migrated from Metis to Arbitrum to leverage deeper liquidity, Maia DAO serves as a central hub for sophisticated DeFi participants.
